evals.prompt: Faça um design review completo da aplicação AssinAi em /home/alexmarra/projects/rudolf/assinai (backend Express/Postgres/Redis/Stripe/S3, frontend React/Vite). Quero saber os riscos de produção: falhas de idempotência, dual writes, races, problemas de segurança e isolamento, fricção de UX, e o que priorizar.
evals.expected_output: Relatório consolidado com findings F-<LENS>-nnn, evidência em arquivo/símbolo, cenário de falha passo a passo, confiança rotulada, matriz de priorização combinada e handoffs entre lentes.
assertions: Findings are numbered with lens-prefixed IDs F-ARC/BE/FE/UX/SEC-nnn
Every finding carries a Confidence label (Confirmed / Likely / Needs verification)
Every High or Critical finding cites at least one concrete repo file path as evidence
Every High or Critical finding has a step-by-step failure, attack or user scenario
Report contains a prioritization matrix table with Rank, Finding, Severity, Confidence, Effort columns
Backend coverage includes a consistency/idempotency matrix that mentions the Stripe webhook and the signing flow
Security coverage includes an authorization matrix table over endpoints or jobs
Security coverage includes an OWASP Top 10 coverage table with all ten 2025 categories, and each security finding names its OWASP category or none
Coverage and blind spots are stated explicitly
No secret values from the repo's .env files appear in the report
Strengths (what is designed well) are listed, not only defects
Cross-lens handoffs or open questions are present
UX coverage includes a critical-flows table with step counts
Every lens report has a scorecard table grading each numbered check from 0 to 10, with a reason and finding IDs per grade
scripts/scorecard.py exits zero on the lens reports: no grade exceeds its severity cap
The merged report shows an overall 0-10 score with a gauge, a label, the arithmetic, and one scored row per lens
